risk_note: Admin console top-bar search (apps/admin; no money logic; codex-run classed it RV2 because App.tsx is touched, so the Codex review ran on the money track). Contract CT-24 adminSearch (planned; backend not done, developed against the contract with a fake server); visuals per the finalized spec design/specs/admin-search.md. Input.Search in the top bar of permitted pages only; one request on enter or the search icon, trimmed q, blank not sent, in-flight duplicates dropped; 20001 shown by the input and network / 5xx via message.error, input kept; a single user hit opens the user detail; order / withdrawal hits (no detail page yet) are listed and stay on the page; candidate list with keyboard, focus and screen-reader names; truncated hint; no-hit text never mentions permission. Rule tests by Codex in two calls plus one orchestrator mechanical fix counted as the exception (vitest 5 toHaveTextContent is whole-text equality: four browser assertions switched to toMatchTextContent, meaning unchanged); Claude spec-test review r2 pass; red on the test machine (red/3: 31 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5; test machine verify-fast/4 and browser/6, browser/7 green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 fail (S1: a no-hit check forced a listbox; 2 S2), round 2 pass after Codex round 2 (2 S2: footer inside the listbox, order hits must not navigate; carried into the implementation constraints)
